exposure: human milk maturation stages (colostrum, transition, mature milks)
cohort: The study included women who had delivered 22 term and 22 preterm infants, providing a total of 44 human milk samples.
finding: Presepsin (PSEP) was detected in all human milk samples, with higher concentrations observed in preterm infant milk compared to term infant milk, and in colostrum compared to transition and mature milks.
mod_finding: The degrees of maturation of human milk subtypes were found to be dependent on both delivery mode and gender.
cross-section timing: Human milk samples were collected at different maturation stages (colostrum, transition, and mature milks).
gest_age: Infants were categorized as term (T) or preterm (PT), but specific gestational age ranges were not provided.
